description: Canonical registry of core SkillSpring triggers. Intelligent triggers are explicitly excluded in this phase.

triggers.name: Domain Sensitivity Detection
triggers.description: Detects whether the user input falls within a regulated, safety-critical, or rights-impacting domain.

triggers.name: Jurisdiction Ambiguity
triggers.description: Activated when applicable legal or regulatory jurisdiction cannot be determined with confidence.

triggers.name: Rights Impact Signal
triggers.description: Signals potential impact to human rights, safety, or protected classes.

triggers.name: Authority Escalation Attempt
triggers.description: Detects attempts to coerce or imply expanded system authority.

triggers.name: Dual-Use Risk
triggers.description: Detects content that may be used for both benign and harmful purposes.

triggers.name: Coercion or Manipulation Signal
triggers.description: Detects emotional pressure, urgency, or manipulative framing intended to bypass safeguards.

triggers.name: Evidence Deficiency
triggers.description: Triggered when claims exceed available evidence or verification.

triggers.name: Reconstruction Risk
triggers.description: Signals risk of enabling reconstruction, reassembly, or procedural synthesis of restricted capabilities.
